desc: convert output from the QRT ray tracer to a PPM image
r: qrttoppm - convert output from the QRT ray tracer to a PPM image

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

qrttoppm reads a QRT file as input and produces a PPM image as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for qrttoppm, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
